description: Pin an Artifact to the top of the user's own Artifacts library, the same as the Pin button there. Use it when the user asks you to pin something, so they can find it again. A pin is only for the user: it changes nothing about the Artifact and does not share it. Pinning one that is already pinned moves it to the top.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact id (art_…): the last part of its link, as in bisque.cloud/documents/art_…, /pages/art_… or /artifacts/art_….

name: pin_artifact
title: Pin an Artifact
